_note: The kit's profile for ITSELF. Unlike every other target, the kit is not installed by copying the engine into .claude/hooks/ — settings.json wires hooks straight at engine/hooks/_client.py, the live source. A copy would be a second engine that drifts from the one under development, and stale duplicated engine code is the exact class of bug this repo shipped fixes for on 2026-08-01 (three forked command splitters, a daemon serving pre-update hooks). engine/hooks/ sits at the same depth as .claude/hooks/, so _constants' PROJECT_ROOT derivation is unchanged.

G1.name: Engine tests
G1.desc: The stdlib unittest suite is green. PASS = exits 0.

G2.name: Install round-trip
G2.desc: Installer changes are only proven by installing: install.sh into a scratch repo, then update.sh, then health-check with zero ERRs. PASS = health-check exits 0.

G3.name: Blast radius
G3.desc: This kit ships to every project repo, so a bug here propagates everywhere. Confirm: engine change matched in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, schema keys landed in kit.config.example.{json,md} AND _KIT_DEFAULTS together, no hook added to BLOCKING_HOOKS casually, and settings.json.template wiring changes carry a kit-propagate path (update.sh never rewrites a target's settings.json).
